observations.rule: PHP documents file_exists returning false for symbolic links to nonexistent targets. is_link identifies the symbolic-link entry. The stated stable snapshot and entry types define the required boolean truth table.

optionAudit.exists-and-link: Rejects both nonlink entries and dangling links.

optionAudit.resolved-type: Misses a link with no target type.
optionAudit.accessible-entry: Misses existing entries without the checked access permissions.

optionAudit.consumer-dev-mode: Does not import a dependency’s root-only field.
optionAudit.require-dev-only: Changes installation scope, not field semantics.

optionAudit.commit-after-encrypt: Crash window reuses an already used value.
optionAudit.reserve-before-use: Atomic disjointness plus durability precedes use.

observations.rule: PHPUnit 12.5 expectException accepts instances of the expected class including subclasses; exact get_class equality is stricter.

optionAudit.different-url: Primary URL keys already separate entries.
optionAudit.same-url-different-language: Exposes reuse across the missing language dimension.

optionAudit.global-currency: Loses per-value unit identity and exactness.
optionAudit.typed-money: Carries and enforces both required properties.

observations.rule: Given the explicit consistency and freshness requirements, the snapshot lifetime must be exactly the checkout operation.

optionAudit.user-cache: Stale across the same user’s later checkouts.

observations.rule: PHP autoload includes class files; moving side effects behind an explicitly invoked application factory separates discovery from activation.

optionAudit.explicit-bootstrap: Makes activation an explicit lifecycle decision.

observations.rule: Under immutable-after-publication POSIX files, descriptor-based fstat and reads refer to the same opened object across pathname replacement.

optionAudit.stat-then-open: Replacement can occur between metadata and open.
optionAudit.clear-cache-stat: Freshness does not make operations atomic.
optionAudit.open-then-path-stat: Path metadata may describe another version.
optionAudit.descriptor-consistency: Both observations use the retained file identity.

observations.rule: PostgreSQL unique constraints reject duplicate stored keys; READ COMMITTED prechecks alone do not serialize the stated competing inserts.

optionAudit.unique-display: Case variants are distinct stored keys.
optionAudit.transaction-only: No constraint prevents the competing inserts.

observations.rule: FPM response finishing does not detach the PHP process; the stated durable queue acknowledgement is the recoverable handoff boundary.
The explicitly stated webhook protocol signs raw body bytes; transformation or projection changes the authenticated message.

optionAudit.verify-original: Preserves exact authenticated bytes and dispatch order.
